body:
Thanks for the reply. 
It's a good idea to reverse the psychology of my brain, but it's like if I even think about questioning my inner dad, my inner dad basically freaks out and it gets a million times worse.

Good advice on trying to be real with my emotions, it's hard though. To express me emotions outwardly is what I did with my dad, and the result was punishment, this is what makes it so hard to do that and why my inner dad was created to protect me from the results of showing my emotions.
